name: Your Company
tagline: A haircut, a shave and a conversation — like the old barbershop on the corner
niche: Barbershop: men’s haircuts, straight-razor shaves, beard care

listing.description: A website for a barbershop, men’s salon or tattoo studio. A vintage poster with a spinning barber pole, a letter-board price list, barbers as cards and reviews as newspaper clippings.

seo.title: Your Company — barbershop in Tashkent: haircuts and shaves
seo.description: Men’s haircuts, the royal straight-razor shave and beard care on Shota Rustaveli Street. Online booking, walk-ins welcome, coffee while you wait.
seo.answer: Your Company is a barbershop at 41 Shota Rustaveli Street in Tashkent, open daily from 10:00 to 22:00. A men’s haircut is 150,000 sum, a royal shave with hot towels 120,000 sum, a haircut with beard 220,000 sum. Book on Telegram or by phone; walk-ins are welcome too.

sections.title: Your Company
sections.subtitle: Classic men’s cuts, straight-razor shaves with hot towels and a beard kept in shape. No rush: every guest gets an hour and a cup of coffee.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A barbershop people return to for years
sections.text: We opened in 2019 in an old house on Rustaveli: leather chairs, tiled floor, a record player. Six barbers, each with their own hand — from strict classics to short fades. We cut only men and boys, sterilise tools after every guest and use single-use razor blades.

sections.label: Price list
sections.title: What we do
sections.intro: Prices are for the barber’s work, including wash, styling and products.

items.title: Men’s haircut
items.text: Consultation, wash, scissor and clipper cut, styling.

items.title: Haircut + beard
items.text: Haircut and beard shaping with a hot towel and oil.

items.title: Royal shave
items.text: Steam, three hot towels, straight razor, cooling mask.

items.title: Beard shaping
items.text: Shape, line-up, balm. For those who cut at home but trust us with the beard.

items.title: Clipper cut
items.text: One guard all over and a neat outline.

items.title: Kids’ haircut
items.text: Boys under 12. Cartoons on a tablet and a lollipop at the end.

items.title: Grey blending
items.text: Toning that keeps a natural look and washes out in 4–6 weeks.

items.title: Coffee and a chat
items.text: We talk about what you want and what suits your head shape and hair type.

items.title: Wash
items.text: Shampoo for your scalp and a massage — five minutes of quiet.

items.title: The barber’s work
items.text: Scissors, clippers, razor. No rush — we give each guest an hour.

items.title: Styling and tips
items.text: We show how to style at home and suggest products — without pushing.

items.name: Father and son
features: Two haircuts at the same time

items.quote: I’ve been going to Bakhtiyor for three years. Never once had to explain again what I want — he remembers.
items.author: Ruslan

items.quote: Brought my son for his first haircut — he didn’t cry and then asked to come back.
items.author: Otabek

items.quote: A royal shave before the wedding was the best thing I did that day before the registry office.
items.author: Sherzod

items.q: Do I need to book in advance?
items.a: Better to book on Telegram or by phone — then your barber will definitely be free. If there’s a slot, we take walk-ins too.

items.q: How long does a haircut take?
items.a: About an hour including consultation, wash and styling. A clipper cut is 30 minutes, a royal shave 45.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: Take a seat
sections.text: Message us on Telegram or call — we’ll find a time and a barber. Running more than 15 minutes late? Let us know and we’ll reschedule.
